page.overview:
What is Cerulean Cape?

Cerulean Cape is an area just past the bridge where the five trainers you battle with. Bill's house is on the edge of the Cerulean Cape. To get to Bill's house, you have to go through the maze of trainers. It is located in Route 25. Category:Kanto locations
